title: Falcon IDs: transparent logo + replace role-play wording with novelty

requirements.summary: Generate a transparent-background Falcon IDs logo asset and switch all logo renders to use it.
acceptanceCriteria: A new transparent logo image exists under frontend/public/assets/generated and visually has no white background.
All pages/components that render the logo (e.g., header and landing hero) reference the new transparent logo filename.
The rendered logo blends correctly on dark backgrounds with no visible white box/padding artifact.
No broken image links occur in the header or landing page after the filename switch.

file_operations.description: Create a transparent-background version of the existing logo (per imageRequirements edit: falcon-ids-logo.dim_1200x300.png > falcon-ids-logo-transparent.dim_1200x300.png).
Update the header logo image src to reference frontend/public/assets/generated/falcon-ids-logo-transparent.dim_1200x300.png and ensure alt text remains correct for accessibility.
Update the landing hero logo image src to reference frontend/public/assets/generated/falcon-ids-logo-transparent.dim_1200x300.png and confirm it renders correctly on the page’s dark background.

requirements.summary: Replace all user-facing 'role-play' wording with 'novelty' across the UI, including disclaimers and ID watermark text, while keeping the 'not real identification' meaning.
acceptanceCriteria: All user-visible occurrences of "role-play"/"roleplay"/"ROLEPLAY" across the UI are replaced with "novelty"/"NOVELTY" as appropriate.
Centralized copy in frontend/src/content/copy.ts no longer contains "roleplay" wording and instead uses "novelty" wording.
The ID card watermark (frontend/src/components/IdWatermark.tsx) no longer says "ROLEPLAY ONLY" and instead uses "NOVELTY" wording while still stating it is not valid identification.

The disclaimer banner component (frontend/src/components/RoleplayDisclaimerBanner.tsx) no longer displays "ROLEPLAY USE ONLY" and is updated to "NOVELTY USE ONLY" (component may be renamed, but functionality and rendering remain intact).
Landing page hero and disclaimer sections (frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx) no longer describe the service as "roleplay" and instead describe it as "novelty".
New order page copy (e.g., shipping section title and subtitle/disclaimer sourced from COPY) no longer includes "Roleplay" phrasing and instead uses "Novelty" phrasing.

file_operations.description: Replace all role-play/roleplay wording in centralized strings with novelty wording while preserving the meaning that IDs are not real identification (including updating any banner/disclaimer/order-form strings).
Update watermark text from "ROLEPLAY ONLY" to "NOVELTY" wording while still clearly stating "NOT VALID IDENTIFICATION" (or equivalent meaning).
Update the banner copy from "ROLEPLAY USE ONLY" to "NOVELTY USE ONLY" while preserving the "NOT REAL IDENTIFICATION" meaning.
Optionally rename the component file to reflect the new terminology (e.g., NoveltyDisclaimerBanner) while keeping identical rendering behavior and ensuring all imports/usages are updated accordingly.
Update the disclaimer banner import/usage if the component is renamed; ensure the banner still renders at the top of the shell.
Replace user-facing roleplay wording in the hero and disclaimer sections with novelty wording; ensure any displayed disclaimer text sourced from COPY reflects the updated terminology.
Replace any remaining roleplay wording in headings/labels (e.g., shipping section title) with novelty wording; ensure subtitle/disclaimer sourced from COPY reflects the updated terminology.
Replace the footer text "ROLEPLAY IDENTIFICATION • NOT VALID FOR OFFICIAL USE" with novelty wording while keeping the same 'not valid' meaning.
Replace any remaining user-facing roleplay wording (e.g., dashboard subtitle and empty-state messaging) with novelty wording.
Ensure the order detail page’s disclaimer/banner copy uses the updated novelty wording (primarily via COPY), and replace any direct roleplay text if present.

requirements.summary: Ensure the brand name is consistently presented as “Falcon IDs” across user-facing text and metadata.
acceptanceCriteria: Any long-form disclaimers/copy that mention "RF-FALCON-IDS" are updated to say "Falcon IDs" (or "FALCON IDs" if matching existing stylistic capitalization) consistently.
The logo alt text remains correct for accessibility and reflects the brand name (e.g., "Falcon IDs"/"FALCON IDs").
Browser tab title remains branded for Falcon IDs (frontend/index.html).

file_operations.description: Update any brand/company mentions in disclaimers and long-form copy (e.g., replacing "RF-FALCON-IDS" with "Falcon IDs") while preserving the non-real-ID disclaimer meaning.
Ensure the logo alt text consistently reflects the brand name as "Falcon IDs" (or the chosen consistent capitalization) after the logo filename switch.
Ensure the landing logo alt text and any brand mentions in visible copy/disclaimers consistently use "Falcon IDs".
Verify the document title remains correctly branded for Falcon IDs; adjust only if any non-matching variant is found.
